title: The Header That Shocked Europe

facts.claim: Greece played Portugal in the Euro 2004 final in Lisbon.
Angelos Charisteas scored the only goal with a header from a corner.
Greece were coached by Otto Rehhagel.
Greece's title is regarded as one of the biggest upsets in the tournament's history.

narration.text: Almost nobody expected Greece to win Euro 2004.
Greece were coached by Otto Rehhagel.
Angelos Charisteas rose and headed it in.
That header won the final. Every goal has a story.
